title: Two or more wythes.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating for wall panels consisting of two or more wythes shall be permitted to be determined by the formula:

R = (R 0.59 +R 0.59 + ... + Rn0.59) (Equation 7-4) 1 2 1.7

where: R = The fire endurance of the assembly, minutes. R , R , and R = The fire endurances of the individual wythes, minutes. Values of R 0.59 for use in Equation 7-4 1 2 n n are given in Table 721.2.1.2(1). Calculated fire-resistance ratings are shown in Table 721.2.1.2(2). VALUES OF R 0.59 FOR USE IN EQUATION 7-4 n
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 pound per cubic foot = 16.02 kg/m3.

FIRE-RESISTANCE RATINGS BASED ON R0.59
